elements.description: Surface app bar with directional Back, DATA SEARCH eyebrow, and Choose a space title.
Supporting copy explains that a space owns its conversations and knowledge sources.
Scrollable list contains only existing accessible spaces and supports continued paging.
Each full-width space row shows its name and only server-confirmed file and conversation counts.
Load more action appears only when another space page is available.
Review note states that Android does not create, rename, or delete spaces in this flow.
No-space state blocks entry and offers Refresh and Return home without inventing a space.
Offline, permission, and expired-session variants hide stale space names and provide a safe action.
Conversation app bar contains Back, conversations action, title, selected space, and sources action.
Answer-scope chip states either all indexed sources or the exact number of pinned sources.
Transcript is ordered oldest to newest and can load older pages without claiming a partial history is complete.
User message uses the primary container and includes readable delivery state and time.
Assistant message is visually distinct, supports Markdown, code, links and copy, and is the generated answer rather than a search result.
Waiting and streaming status is announced without announcing every streamed token.
Interrupted stream remains visibly incomplete with reconciliation or manual retry; it never becomes a completed answer silently.
Structured source-reference chips appear below an assistant message only when the confirmed message contract returns them.
Multiline message composer remains reachable above the IME and preserves a per-account, per-conversation draft.
48dp Send action prevents duplicate submission and has nearby text explaining disabled states.
Empty conversation state invites a question about the selected space and keeps source management secondary.
Offline, permission, and session variants preserve or hide content according to authorization and never auto-send on reconnect.
Expanded layout makes the conversation the widest center pane between conversations and sources.
Drawer or start-pane header names the selected space and has a localized Close action in compact layout.
New conversation primary action opens the create flow and prevents duplicate creation.
Newest-first conversation list remains scoped to Data Search and the selected space.
Selected conversation row uses container, label, and selection semantics rather than color alone.
Each row exposes separately labelled rename and delete actions with 48dp targets.
Load more conversations appears while another page exists and does not reorder loaded rows.
Empty state offers Start a conversation and does not create multiple threads while a request is pending.
Loading, refresh failure, offline, permission, and session states do not mix conversations from another space.
Modal sheet header distinguishes New conversation from Rename conversation and provides Close.
Persistent Conversation name label remains visible with input content.
Single text field preserves user input and shows no invented server character limit.
Supporting copy says the conversation stays inside the selected space.
Optional model selector appears only when confirmed model catalogue and pinning are available.
Cancel precedes the primary action in reading and focus order.
Create or Save action disables during submission and never creates a second conversation on retry.
Inline validation, network, permission, and model-pinning failures preserve the conversation and entered title.
Modal scrim obscures the conversation list while preserving context.
Error-container delete icon communicates destructive intent without relying on color alone.
Dialog title includes the conversation name.
Body says the transcript is permanently deleted while all space files remain unchanged.
The active row stays visible until the server confirms deletion.
Cancel is the initial-focus safe action.
Delete conversation is an explicit danger action and never announces success early.
Sources header shows the selected space and returns to the active conversation in compact layout.
Add source action offers system file picker and conditional Add text flow.
Explanation states that uploaded files affect answers only after successful indexing.
Filter chips separate all, indexed, not indexed, and failed sources with written labels.
Unified source list joins file and knowledge state by stable id rather than file name.
Each source row shows name and confirmed metadata plus separate File safety and Answer index statuses.
Index or Retry appears only for the applicable confirmed state and permission.
Source row opens details; rename and delete remain separate labelled actions.
Empty state offers an allowed add path; filtered-empty state can restore all sources.
Partial-read, offline, permission, and session variants identify stale or hidden content safely.
Expanded layout presents sources as a supporting end pane without shrinking the conversation below readability.
Add source header includes Back and the selected space.
Choice panel distinguishes Choose file from conditional Add text as a file.
Add-text variant has persistent File name and Content labels and no invented MIME or size promise.
Written stages separate local preparation, registration, byte upload, completion, safety scan, and indexing.
Only the active stage shows an accessible progress indicator; no fake percentage is displayed.
Ready but not indexed, quarantined, failed, expired upload, and ambiguous recovery are distinct states.
Cancel is available only when the confirmed operation can be cancelled safely.
Done returns to sources only after a confirmed terminal state.
Offline, permission, and session variants do not repeat a registration, upload, or indexing request blindly.
Source details app bar has directional Back and the selected-space label.
Source name and confirmed type are readable without truncating at large font scale.
File safety panel independently renders uploaded, scanning, ready, or quarantined.
Answer index panel independently renders not started, pending, indexing, indexed, or failed.
RAG impact explains whether this source can currently contribute to answers.
Include or remove from this conversation updates retrieval scope only and never grants file access.
Index or Retry and Rename appear only when confirmed by state, contract, and permission.
Delete source is a full-width danger action with separate confirmation.
Offline, partial, permission, and session variants hide or freeze actions without fabricating state.
Bottom sheet or end-pane header names Answer scope and provides Close.
All indexed sources option explains that it is the default represented by no pinned files.
Selected sources only option explains that any pin narrows answers to the pinned subset.
Source checklist shows indexed files and the confirmed server pin state.
Unindexed source remains visible but disabled with a written reason.
Inline failure restores the affected checkbox to server state and does not alter earlier answers.
Use all removes every pin without deleting files or changing space.
Done closes the scope surface and returns focus to its trigger.
Loading, empty, offline, permission, and session variants do not treat cached pins as authorization.
Modal scrim obscures source details while preserving context.
Error-container source-delete icon communicates destructive intent beyond color.
Dialog title includes the source file name.
Body says the source stops contributing to every conversation in the space and leaves pinned scopes.
Index and chunk purge wording appears only when confirmed by the working backend contract.
The source remains visible until deletion is confirmed by the service.
Cancel is the initial-focus safe action.
Delete source is an explicit danger action and never announces success early.
